n436bde4783.headline: This week it will be decided if the tariff project becomes law
n436bde4783.summary: Argentina's Senate will decide whether to approve a bill moderating tariff increases or support a government proposal to halve VAT for residential electricity, gas, and water users.
n436bde4783.why: Utility tariffs and tax policies directly affect household expenses and inflation in Argentina, influencing economic stability and consumer spending.
